name: Integrated Nutrition
headline: Nourishment that works with your real life.
summary: Nourish capacity: energy, recovery, strength, resilience and sustainable eating behaviors.
description: Practical nutrition coaching that connects nourishment to energy, strength, recovery, stress, lifestyle, preferences and the realities of everyday life. The focus is workable routines, not rigid rules or another diet.
metaDescription: Practical nutrition coaching in Brighton and Howell, MI, or virtually, connecting what you eat to energy, strength, recovery and real life.
scopeNote: Integrated Nutrition is nutrition coaching, not medical nutrition therapy. It does not diagnose or treat medical conditions or eating disorders, or prescribe diets for them. Those needs stay with your physician or a registered dietitian, and we’ll help you find the right professional.

value.heading: How we help
value.lead: Integrated Nutrition at TAB starts with how you actually live, train, recover and eat.
paragraphs: We look at your routines, preferences, energy, training and recovery together, then build fueling habits that fit your life rather than handing you a rigid plan.
Because it sits alongside strength, massage and coaching at TAB, nutrition can be coordinated with the rest of your support when that genuinely helps.

items.q: Will you give me a meal plan?
items.a: We build practical meal structure and routines with you rather than a rigid plan to follow. Diets for medical conditions stay with your physician or a registered dietitian.

items.q: Can nutrition coaching work alongside strength training?
items.a: Yes. Fueling, training and recovery work best together, and we can coordinate them when that helps your goals.
Yes. Nutrition coaching is available virtually and in person.
